newsitem.title: USA: Biomatrix seen posting Q4 oper profit - report.
newsitem.headline: Biomatrix seen posting Q4 oper profit - report.

text.p: Biomatrix Inc is seen generating an operating profit by the fourth quarter of 1997, a Business Week article said.

Len Bogner, former Prudential Securities analyst who now runs BGS Associates, told Business Week he expected Biomatrix to post an operating profit, exclusive of royalties, licensing and other fees, by the fourth quarter.
Bogner said he expected Biomatrix's share price to reach $25 by year-end and $50 in 18 months, the June 30 issue of the magazine said.
Biomatrix develops and manufactures products made from series of proprietary biological polymers used in therapeutic medical applications.
Shares of Biomatrix were 1-7/8 higher at 18-7/8 early Friday afternoon.
